summary: Iter 60 — backend pytest 12/12 PASSED (Excel template + import with dedup + .csv reject, campaign /pause /resume /cancel /progress endpoints with correct 400 shapes for invalid states, /run with empty audience returns 400 'Audiencia vazia', /run with classic mode seeds campaign_deliveries and returns mode=classic + queued+total, pause/resume during execution flips status to pausada then em_execucao, scheduler._process_scheduled_campaigns picks up status='programada' with past scheduled_at and transitions to em_execucao). Frontend smoke verified Listas de Contato tab shows Modelo Excel + Importar Excel buttons (data-testid=download-template-btn, import-excel-btn) and clicking Modelo Excel downloads modelo-contatos.xlsx (network request to /api/crm/contact-lists/template.xlsx returns 200).

coverage_areas: GET /api/crm/contact-lists/template.xlsx returns 200 + correct content-type + Content-Disposition + valid xlsx with sheet 'Contatos' and headers Nome/Telefone/Email
POST /api/crm/contact-lists/import-excel parses xlsx, dedup by phone, skips empty phone, returns {id,name,imported_count,skipped_count}
POST /api/crm/campaigns/{id}/run with empty audience returns 400 'Audiencia vazia'
POST /api/crm/campaigns/{id}/cancel returns 400 when status not in [em_execucao,pausada,programada]
GET /api/crm/campaigns/{id}/progress returns {campaign, totals:{pending,sending,sent,failed,total}, sent[], failed[], pending[], sending[]}
POST /api/crm/campaigns/{id}/run classic mode seeds campaign_deliveries, returns {mode:'classic', queued:true, total:N}, campaign goes to em_execucao
pause during em_execucao flips status to 'pausada' (verified via progress.campaign.status)
resume from 'pausada' flips status back to em_execucao/concluida
scheduler._process_scheduled_campaigns picks status='programada' with past scheduled_at, transitions to em_execucao and seeds deliveries

verified.listas_contato_tab_buttons: data-testid=download-template-btn and data-testid=import-excel-btn render in Listas de Contato tab
verified.template_download: Click download-template-btn triggers download (suggested filename 'modelo-contatos.xlsx') and network call to /api/crm/contact-lists/template.xlsx returns 200
verified.pausada_label_orange: Not visible in current tenant (no paused campaign live) — could not visually verify color

not_verified_due_to_state: view-campaign-<id>, pause-campaign-<id>, resume-campaign-<id> data-testids — all 3 listed campaigns are status=Rascunho so these buttons aren't rendered. Visual eye/play/edit icons are present in the Acoes column but their data-testid attributes weren't queryable in the current state.
Campaign progress modal (campaign-progress-modal) — would only open for concluida/em_execucao/pausada/cancelada campaigns; none exist in tenant.

critical_code_review_comments: crm_routes._fire_campaign_classic correctly wipes campaign_deliveries before re-runs (line 2052) — safe for re-execution.
_classic_runner._wait_if_paused polls every 5s — acceptable, but consider event-based wakeup later if many campaigns paused simultaneously.
scheduler._process_scheduled_campaigns uses find_one_and_update for atomic claim — concurrent-safe. Good.
POST /campaigns/{id}/cancel allows from [em_execucao, pausada, programada] only — rascunho can't be cancelled (returns 400). Verify UX expects this.
import_contact_list_excel: the `name` query param defaults to 'Lista Importada' when omitted — consider requiring it to avoid noisy duplicates.

Minor: action_items list on Listagem tab shows eye icons even for Rascunho campaigns but they open the old AudienceModal — that's per-spec (only concluida/em_execucao/pausada/cancelada open the new CampaignProgressModal). The data-testid pattern view-campaign-<id> should still be set on the rascunho/programada eye-icon for testability — currently we couldn't find it via that selector.
action_items: Optional: add data-testid=view-campaign-<id> also on the rascunho/programada eye-button (currently absent) so the audience modal flow is testable end-to-end.
Optional: seed a campaign with status=em_execucao in dev tenant so QA can visually verify pause-campaign / resume-campaign / Pausada orange badge.

success_rate.frontend: Partial — Excel template/import UI verified; pause/resume/progress UI not visible because no em_execucao/pausada campaign exists in tenant
